A general contractor you can reach any hour

AR Build Works is led by Anderson Ramsumair and works out of Harripaul Village, Diamond. We handle structural work and interior finishing, so one team can carry your job from the foundation to the final panel.

  • Open 24 hours: call or message when you need us.
  • Foundation, concrete, roofing and ceiling systems in one crew.
  • Interior finishes: SPC flooring, UV marble sheet, WPC wall panels, gypsum and PVC ceilings.
